plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for SmartByte Ethernet switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, chassis temperature, fan status, power supply state, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 56166).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the SmartByte switch over the past minute as a 0-100 percentage (NMS-SYS-MIB cpuUtilized scalar).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the SmartByte switch as a 0-100 percentage (NMS-SYS-MIB memUtilized scalar).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of each SmartByte sensor in degrees Celsius (NMS-SYS-MIB temperatureValue, no scale). High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan state of the SmartByte switch (NMS-SYS-MIB fanStatus), normalized so that 1 = normal and 2 = failure. Other codes are not emitted.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power supply state of the SmartByte switch (NMS-SYS-MIB powerState), normalized so that 1 = on and 2 = off. Other codes are not emitted.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
